newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta gains extra tourists in early 1997.
newsitem.headline: Malta gains extra tourists in early 1997.

text.p: Tourist visitors to Malta rose by three percent in the first four months of this year, to 276,594 compared with the same period last year, the Office of Statistics said on Monday.
The biggest increase was in April, when arrivals rose 16.7 percent to 105,617 over the same month in 1996, it said.
The Statistics Office said arrivals from Britain, Malta's biggest tourism market, were up 5.6 percent to 107,029 between January and April.
German tourists, the second most numerous, increased by 10.6 percent to 69,596.
The Office said earnings from tourism between January and March reached 43.4 million Malta pounds ($113 million), an increase of 10 percent. Figures for April were not yet available.
Tourism arrivals dropped by six percent in 1995 and 1996.
